title: 5/6/26: Overcast Conditions with a High of 70 and Low of 55, Evening Temp at 55; Light Winds and Minimal Precip Chance… - NewsBreak
text:
By Source Staff ,
1 hours ago Current conditions in Maury County at 10:00 PM show a temperature of 55.4°F with a light wind from the southeast at 6.3 mph. The sky is overcast, and there has been no precipitation reported at this time.
Earlier today, the high reached 70.3°F with a low of 54.9°F. The region experienced heavy rain throughout the day, accumulating a total of 1.67 in, with wind gusts up to 14.5 mph. Tonight, temperatures are expected to drop to a low of 54.9°F, with a slight chance of precipitation at 16% and winds remaining light.
No official weather warnings are currently active for this area. Conditions are likely to remain consistent through the night as clouds persist.
